report.incidentSummary: Starting at 13:40 IST (08:10 UTC) on 2026-09-17, autopay mandate registrations for Gomti Bank began failing at an elevated rate (~45%), pulling Gomti mandate success down from ~97% to ~52%. All other partner banks and internal platform components remained healthy. The failures were caused by upstream rejections from Gomti Bank's mandate API returning HTTP 422 with response code U16 ('risk threshold exceeded').
report.rootCauseStatement: Gomti Bank's upstream mandate registration gateway or risk evaluation engine began rejecting approximately 45% of mandate creation requests with HTTP 422 and error code U16 ('risk threshold exceeded') starting at 08:10:02 UTC. Internal services, database performance, and all other partner banks operated normally throughout the incident window.

hypotheses.cause: Gomti Bank upstream mandate registration API or internal risk engine started rejecting mandate creation requests with error code U16 ('risk threshold exceeded')
hypotheses.rationale: Mandate failures and bank error rates are strictly isolated to Gomti Bank starting at 08:10 UTC. Bank connector and mandate-service logs confirm all 570+ errors are HTTP 422 rejections from Gomti Bank returning U16 'risk threshold exceeded', with no latency degradation or timeouts.

hypotheses.cause: Configuration update CHG-48222 on mandate-service triggered downstream rejections or gateway timeouts
hypotheses.rationale: CHG-48222 only increased npci.timeout_ms from 8000ms to 10000ms at 08:00 UTC, 10 minutes prior to onset. Furthermore, bank-connector recorded near-zero timeouts across all banks, and errors were specific to Gomti Bank returning HTTP 422 rather than timeout or client bad request errors across all banks.

facts.statement: Gomti Bank mandate success rate dropped from 96.67% at 08:05 UTC to 75.69% at 08:10 UTC and hovered between 51% and 56% through 10:25 UTC, while all other partner banks remained between 96% and 97%.
bank-connector bank_error_rate for Gomti Bank jumped from 0.64% at 08:05 UTC to 21.78% at 08:10 UTC and persisted between 40% and 48% through 10:25 UTC, whereas other banks stayed below 1%.
All 570 error logs in bank-connector and all 602 error logs in mandate-service were exclusively attributed to Gomti Bank, starting at 08:10:02 UTC.
bank-connector logged HTTP 422 responses on POST /mandates from Gomti Bank with body {"code":"U16","message":"risk threshold exceeded"}.
bank_latency_p95_ms and timeout_count remained flat and nominal across all banks including Gomti Bank, with timeouts near zero.
Database metrics (CPU utilization, db_lock_wait_ms, active_connections, and slow queries) remained stable with no abnormal spikes or errors during the window.
Configuration change CHG-48222 was applied to mandate-service at 08:00:00 UTC, increasing npci.timeout_ms from 8000ms to 10000ms.

inferences.statement: The issue is not a general NPCI degradation or internal application outage, because mandate registrations for all partner banks other than Gomti Bank operated with normal ~97% success rates.
Gomti Bank deployed or tightened an automated fraud or risk threshold rule at approximately 08:10 UTC that causes legitimate autopay mandate registrations to fail with error code U16.

The config change CHG-48222 was not the cause of the Gomti Bank failures because mandate-service latencies and timeouts did not rise, and errors were HTTP 422 rejections from Gomti rather than gateway timeouts.

assumptions.statement: Gomti Bank core banking or mandate processing service updated internal fraud/risk scoring models or threshold rules around 08:10 UTC without prior communication to partners.

timeline.event: CHG-48222 applied to mandate-service by v.rao, increasing npci.timeout_ms from 8000ms to 10000ms.
First recorded error in mandate-service showing Gomti Bank declining mandate with 'U16 risk threshold exceeded'.
First HTTP 422 error logged in bank-connector for POST /mandates from Gomti Bank API with error code U16.
Gomti Bank mandate success rate drops to ~52.58% and bank_error_rate jumps to ~42.99%, where it remains for the duration of the investigation window.
SEV2 Incident INC-4557 reported by Payments product manager.

confidence.rationale: Direct telemetry and application logs from both bank-connector and mandate-service confirm that all errors are 100% isolated to Gomti Bank returning HTTP 422 code U16 ('risk threshold exceeded'). Internal services, database metrics, and all other partner banks showed zero degradation.

gaps.description: bank_latency_p95_ms metric query returned partial results due to unreadable records in telemetry store.
gaps.impact: Negligible impact; 33 data points across the window were retrieved and confirmed latency remained flat around 1772ms.

gaps.description: Lack of direct access to Gomti Bank upstream partner status page or ticket system.
gaps.impact: Minor impact; cannot confirm the exact internal rule or parameter Gomti modified, but the error payload from Gomti API explicitly identifies U16 risk threshold exceeded.

recommendedActions.action: Escalate to Gomti Bank partner integrations and merchant operations team regarding the surge in U16 'risk threshold exceeded' declines on mandate registrations.
recommendedActions.rationale: The upstream bank is declining valid user mandate registrations with HTTP 422 U16, indicating a misconfigured or overly restrictive fraud/risk threshold on their side.
recommendedActions.verification: Monitor Gomti Bank bank_error_rate in bank-connector returning to baseline (<1%) and mandate_success_rate returning to ~97%.

recommendedActions.action: Update frontend UI messaging and user advisory for Gomti Bank account holders attempting SIP autopay setup.
recommendedActions.rationale: Informing Gomti Bank users of temporary partner bank degradation prevents repeated failed attempts and customer support overhead.
recommendedActions.verification: Check frontend analytics for reduced mandate retry storm on Gomti accounts.

recommendedActions.action: Review mandate-service timeout configuration and align with api-gateway's 5000ms upstream timeout.
recommendedActions.rationale: CHG-48222 set npci.timeout_ms to 10000ms while api-gateway has a 5000ms timeout to mandate-service, creating a risk of premature gateway timeouts if NPCI experiences latency in the future.
recommendedActions.verification: Verify mandate-service and api-gateway timeout configurations match the system architectural standards.

findings.summary: Database metrics for db_lock_wait_ms, cpu_utilization, active_connections, and slow_queries_per_min showed no elevation around 08:10 UTC or throughout the 07:30-10:30 UTC window. Lock contention, slow queries, and connection pool exhaustion on the primary database did not cause the autopay setup issues.

observations.statement: database db_lock_wait_ms remained steady between 3.61 ms and 4.12 ms (mean 3.87 ms) throughout 07:30 to 10:30 UTC, measuring 3.89 ms at 08:10 UTC with no spike or elevation.
database cpu_utilization remained stable between 33.11% and 35.63% (mean 34.49%) across the entire window, measuring 35.22% at 08:10 UTC.
database active_connections remained steady between 158.9 and 173.2 (mean 165.6), measuring 167.1 connections at 08:10 UTC, showing no connection pool exhaustion or surge.
database slow_queries_per_min stayed flat between 1.2/min and 4.6/min (mean 2.61/min), recording 2.6/min at 08:10 UTC.

database WARN/ERROR logs between 07:30 and 10:30 UTC contained only 7 sporadic slow query warnings on holdings, folios, and sip_schedules tables, with zero database errors or mandate-related slow queries.

Primary database performance was entirely nominal around 08:10 UTC and throughout the incident window; lock contention, slow queries, CPU saturation, and connection pool exhaustion can be ruled out as causes for mandate setup failures.

findings.summary: At 2026-09-17T08:00:00.000Z (~10 minutes before the 08:10 UTC onset), mandate-service received config update CHG-48222 increasing npci.timeout_ms from 8000ms to 10000ms. No changes were made to bank-connector, and no code deployments occurred. Furthermore, api-gateway has a 5000ms timeout to mandate-service, creating a timeout mismatch if NPCI latency exceeds 5s. Historical incidents (PIR-2008 and PIR-1624) show precedent for mandate failures caused by NPCI e-mandate gateway degradation.

observations.statement: At 2026-09-17T08:00:00.000Z (10 minutes before reported incident onset), configuration change CHG-48222 was applied to mandate-service by v.rao, increasing npci.timeout_ms from 8000ms to 10000ms.
No code deployments, rollouts, or configuration updates were made to bank-connector during the 06:00 to 10:30 UTC investigation window. No deployments occurred on mandate-service.

In the dependency graph, api-gateway calls mandate-service synchronously with a 5000ms timeout and 0 retries, whereas mandate-service calls npci (external_api) with configured timeout 8000ms and 1 retry.

Increasing npci.timeout_ms to 10000ms in mandate-service exacerbates a timeout mismatch against api-gateway's 5000ms upstream timeout; any NPCI call taking between 5000ms and 10000ms will cause api-gateway to abort with a gateway timeout while mandate-service is still waiting.

Past incidents PIR-2008 (2026-09-03) and PIR-1624 (2026-08-24) both involved mandate registration failures across banks caused by NPCI e-mandate gateway degradation, resolved by waiting for NPCI recovery and retrying queued mandates.

# Investigation report: Autopay setup failing for some users

**Outcome:** conclusive · **Stop reason:** critic_accepted · **Confidence:** 0.95 · **Written by:** reporting agent

## Summary
Starting at 13:40 IST (08:10 UTC) on 2026-09-17, autopay mandate registrations for Gomti Bank began failing at an elevated rate (~45%), pulling Gomti mandate success down from ~97% to ~52%. All other partner banks and internal platform components remained healthy. The failures were caused by upstream rejections from Gomti Bank's mandate API returning HTTP 422 with response code U16 ('risk threshold exceeded').

**Root cause:** Gomti Bank's upstream mandate registration gateway or risk evaluation engine began rejecting approximately 45% of mandate creation requests with HTTP 422 and error code U16 ('risk threshold exceeded') starting at 08:10:02 UTC. Internal services, database performance, and all other partner banks operated normally throughout the incident window.

## Hypotheses
1. **Gomti Bank upstream mandate registration API or internal risk engine started rejecting mandate creation requests with error code U16 ('risk threshold exceeded')** — `bank-apis`, upstream_dependency_degradation, confidence 0.90, supported
   - Supporting: [ev_1, ev_2, ev_13, ev_17, ev_18, ev_19, ev_20, ev_21, ev_22] · Contradicting: none
   - Mandate failures and bank error rates are strictly isolated to Gomti Bank starting at 08:10 UTC. Bank connector and mandate-service logs confirm all 570+ errors are HTTP 422 rejections from Gomti Bank returning U16 'risk threshold exceeded', with no latency degradation or timeouts.
2. **Configuration update CHG-48222 on mandate-service triggered downstream rejections or gateway timeouts** — `mandate-service`, config_change, confidence 0.10, ruled_out
   - Supporting: [ev_3, ev_9] · Contradicting: [ev_1, ev_2, ev_8, ev_12, ev_15, ev_18, ev_20]
   - CHG-48222 only increased npci.timeout_ms from 8000ms to 10000ms at 08:00 UTC, 10 minutes prior to onset. Furthermore, bank-connector recorded near-zero timeouts across all banks, and errors were specific to Gomti Bank returning HTTP 422 rather than timeout or client bad request errors across all banks.

## Facts
- Gomti Bank mandate success rate dropped from 96.67% at 08:05 UTC to 75.69% at 08:10 UTC and hovered between 51% and 56% through 10:25 UTC, while all other partner banks remained between 96% and 97%. [ev_1]
- bank-connector bank_error_rate for Gomti Bank jumped from 0.64% at 08:05 UTC to 21.78% at 08:10 UTC and persisted between 40% and 48% through 10:25 UTC, whereas other banks stayed below 1%. [ev_2]
- All 570 error logs in bank-connector and all 602 error logs in mandate-service were exclusively attributed to Gomti Bank, starting at 08:10:02 UTC. [ev_21, ev_22]
- bank-connector logged HTTP 422 responses on POST /mandates from Gomti Bank with body {"code":"U16","message":"risk threshold exceeded"}. [ev_18, ev_20]
- bank_latency_p95_ms and timeout_count remained flat and nominal across all banks including Gomti Bank, with timeouts near zero. [ev_8, ev_12]
- Database metrics (CPU utilization, db_lock_wait_ms, active_connections, and slow queries) remained stable with no abnormal spikes or errors during the window. [ev_4, ev_5, ev_6, ev_7, ev_14]
- Configuration change CHG-48222 was applied to mandate-service at 08:00:00 UTC, increasing npci.timeout_ms from 8000ms to 10000ms. [ev_3, ev_9]

## Inferences
- The issue is not a general NPCI degradation or internal application outage, because mandate registrations for all partner banks other than Gomti Bank operated with normal ~97% success rates. [ev_1, ev_2]
- Gomti Bank deployed or tightened an automated fraud or risk threshold rule at approximately 08:10 UTC that causes legitimate autopay mandate registrations to fail with error code U16. [ev_1, ev_2, ev_19, ev_20]
- The config change CHG-48222 was not the cause of the Gomti Bank failures because mandate-service latencies and timeouts did not rise, and errors were HTTP 422 rejections from Gomti rather than gateway timeouts. [ev_3, ev_8, ev_12, ev_15, ev_20]

## Assumptions
- Gomti Bank core banking or mandate processing service updated internal fraud/risk scoring models or threshold rules around 08:10 UTC without prior communication to partners.

## Timeline
- **2026-09-17T08:00:00.000Z (13:30:00 IST)** CHG-48222 applied to mandate-service by v.rao, increasing npci.timeout_ms from 8000ms to 10000ms. [ev_3, ev_9]
- **2026-09-17T08:10:02.145Z (13:40:02 IST)** First recorded error in mandate-service showing Gomti Bank declining mandate with 'U16 risk threshold exceeded'. [ev_17, ev_19, ev_21]
- **2026-09-17T08:10:13.150Z (13:40:13 IST)** First HTTP 422 error logged in bank-connector for POST /mandates from Gomti Bank API with error code U16. [ev_18, ev_20, ev_22]
- **2026-09-17T08:15:00.000Z (13:45:00 IST)** Gomti Bank mandate success rate drops to ~52.58% and bank_error_rate jumps to ~42.99%, where it remains for the duration of the investigation window. [ev_1, ev_2]
- **2026-09-17T09:15:00.000Z (14:45:00 IST)** SEV2 Incident INC-4557 reported by Payments product manager.

## Confidence
0.95: Direct telemetry and application logs from both bank-connector and mandate-service confirm that all errors are 100% isolated to Gomti Bank returning HTTP 422 code U16 ('risk threshold exceeded'). Internal services, database metrics, and all other partner banks showed zero degradation.

## Gaps
- bank_latency_p95_ms metric query returned partial results due to unreadable records in telemetry store. (impact: Negligible impact; 33 data points across the window were retrieved and confirmed latency remained flat around 1772ms.)
- Lack of direct access to Gomti Bank upstream partner status page or ticket system. (impact: Minor impact; cannot confirm the exact internal rule or parameter Gomti modified, but the error payload from Gomti API explicitly identifies U16 risk threshold exceeded.)

## Recommended actions (not executed)
- **[now]** Escalate to Gomti Bank partner integrations and merchant operations team regarding the surge in U16 'risk threshold exceeded' declines on mandate registrations. [ev_1, ev_2, ev_20]
  - Why: The upstream bank is declining valid user mandate registrations with HTTP 422 U16, indicating a misconfigured or overly restrictive fraud/risk threshold on their side.
  - Verify: Monitor Gomti Bank bank_error_rate in bank-connector returning to baseline (<1%) and mandate_success_rate returning to ~97%.
- **[now]** Update frontend UI messaging and user advisory for Gomti Bank account holders attempting SIP autopay setup. [ev_1, ev_19]
  - Why: Informing Gomti Bank users of temporary partner bank degradation prevents repeated failed attempts and customer support overhead.
